notes.title: Cyber Complex Update 1.1.0 "REBOOT" has been released!
notes.content:
[b]Cyber ​​Complex 1.1.0 "REBOOT"[/b]

[i][b]New:[/b][/i]
- New Enemy AI reacting to players strategy
- New Scanner radar animations and reactions
- New Node detection radar visuals
- New improved game mechanics
- New visuals and heal / damage effects
- New stealth / alert mechanics


[i][b]Improvements:[/b][/i]
- Improved 2P Versus and Coop Modes
- Improved playfield, node and enemy visuals
- Improved translations and descriptions


[i][b]Bugfix:[/b][/i]
- 2P Versus HP draw bugfix


[i]*The previous version 1.0.1 is still available for everyone in the "previousVersion" branch unter the beta tab on Steam.[/i]

We hope you enjoy, feedback is very welcome!
